# Introduction

We are going run scrublet for doublet detection

# Libraries

```{r}
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(rscrublet)
library(Matrix)
```

# Parameters

```{r}
subproj <- params$subproj

source(here::here(glue::glue("{subproj}/multiome_analysis/misc/paths.R")))
set.seed(0)
```

# Functions

```{r}

# Piece of code from https://github.com/Single-Cell-Genomics-Group-CNAG-CRG/scripts_and_utils/blob/main/run_scrublet.R
# function to run R scrublet on a Seurat object
# assumes you have RNA counts on your object (@assays$RNA@counts)
# returns the same Seurat object with a "doublet_score" metadata column and 
# also the prediction as logical in "doublet_pred" metadata column
# expected doublet rate from [10x Multiome tables](https://www.epfl.ch/research/facilities/gene-expression-core-facility/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Multiome-10XG-samples-preparation-guidelines-by-GECF-vA.01.pdf)

# remotes::install_github("huyuem/rscrublet")

run_scrublet <- function(seu_obj){
  count_matrix = as.matrix(seu_obj@assays$RNA@counts)
  scrr = scrubDoublets(count_matrix,
                        expected_doublet_rate=0.035,
                        min_counts=2, 
                        min_cells=3, 
                        min_gene_variability_pctl=85, 
                        n_prin_comps=30)

  seu_obj$doublet_score = scrr$doublet_scores_obs
  seu_obj$doublet_pred = scrr$scrubDoublets
  seu_obj
}
```

# Load data

```{r}
df_info <- read_csv(here::here(glue::glue("utils/info_samples.csv")))
df_info <- df_info %>% 
  dplyr::filter(modality =="multiome" & subproject == subproj & quality != "Bad")

df_info <- unique(df_info[, c("gem_id", "patient")])
```

```{r}
list_objects <- lapply(df_info$patient, function(id) {
  obj <- readRDS(here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/2.1_{id}.rds")))
  obj <- run_scrublet(obj)
  file.rename('histogram of doublet scores.pdf', here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{plt_dir}/2.2_histogram_scrublet_{id}.pdf")))
  print(id)
  saveRDS(obj, here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/2.2_{id}.rds")))
})
list_objects <- setNames(list_objects, df_info$patient)
```
